nist_olir_rationale: ISO A.5.15 requires rules for access control which directly correlates with establishing and managing system accounts under AC-2.
ISO A.5.18 governs granting review and modification of access rights aligning with AC-2 account lifecycle procedures.
Both controls enforce approved access authorizations based on organizational access control policies and RBAC.
Enforces technical restrictions on privileged execution environments such as LLM tool calling and agent privilege scopes.
Both mandates restrict users and automated agents to the absolute minimum necessary privileges for duty completion.
Regulates utility software and high-privilege agent action execution in secure development environments.
Requires full lifecycle management and allocation of unique identities for all entities accessing systems.
Controls the verification of authentication factors including passwords tokens and multi-factor authenticators.
Governs storage distribution expiration and cryptographic protection of authenticators and API keys.
Enforces cryptographic storage and generation of authenticators tokens and secret salts.
Requires application-level validation of all incoming data streams and user inputs to prevent injection attacks.
Ensures applications do not expose sensitive internal data memory states or system prompts in error responses.
Enforces boundary controls firewalls and segmentation between untrusted networks and internal model infrastructures.
Requires network separation between public LLM frontends vector databases and private training data backends.
Mandates encryption algorithms and key management for data resting in databases file stores and embeddings.
Requires recording of operational events exceptions faults and security-relevant user/agent transactions.
Guarantees audit trail immutability and non-repudiation through timestamping and cryptographic record signing.
Uses cryptographic hashing (e.g. SHA-256) and digital signatures to confirm audit log authenticity.

Direct response actions taken against verified threat alerts including automated LLM circuit breakers.

nist_olir_rationale: Systematic evaluation and monitoring of security telemetry to determine incident severity.
Real-time automated surveillance of networks systems and application behaviors for anomalous patterns.
